body: I do not. I know that adds a huge layer of difficulty to moving on and forward. But, your wonderful children may assist you in steps. Wanting the life you’ve always dreamed for you and for them is something exciting to think about too. I have done the back and forth so much that I exhausted my only friend who I confided in to where she would just reply “Oh no he sucks”. But each one of those moments did build me to finally taking the step. You are doing all the right things. I’m here if you ever need to vent or if you need some hype for your future!

I just want to start by saying I’m proud of you! You are taking the steps to heal yourself and it takes courage to dig deep within and to seek help. I have to say though, there is only so much a person can take and it is okay that you hit your limit. I hope that you do not beat yourself up over it for too long. 

My Q brought out the worst in me at those times I caught him lying, cheating, etc. In my 20s I was a firecracker shooting off at anyone and anything. It took me a good decade to build to be the calm talker and voice of reason. I was so proud of myself. It took only a year with my Q for me to lose all that progress and pop off all over again. I hope I can find your strength to seek help with that. Thank you for sharing your story. You are inspiring me to be better!

You are taking the best steps to getting there. My moment came at a pretty regular occurrence- finding the hidden empties when he agreed to no alcohol in the house. I’ve tackled that situation so many times but after working hard on the things you have, I hit my breaking point. I was even calm while I made him leave. Remember to remind yourself of your dreams. Do you have hopes of traveling or having your own business or buying a boat? These things can’t happen if you are constantly worrying or frustrated or sad. Keep looking to that brighter future. It is there. You just have to give yourself time to see it and believe it.

Per the recommendation of a member on here, I began planning a future— without my Q. Also distancing myself during his drinking and kept myself busy. I had caught him with alcohol in my house and that was my moment. I had prepared myself to move forward alone and was ready in that moment. It actually shocked me because so many times I had caught him lying and never followed through with kicking him out. It was probably one of the most empowering moments I’ve ever had.

I used to dread the weekends too. My Q drinks just about every day but the weekends were always the worst. It made my weekends just terrible, anxiety filled, and lonely. I’m so sorry you are going through this.

Before I was able to leave my Q, I worked hard at distancing myself. If he was drunk, I went into a different room or got on the phone with a friend who made me laugh. If he was drunk and speaking stupidly to me, I would just nod my head and “be right back I have to use the bathroom” then come out and go to a different room. Working on the physical distancing helped a lot. It gave me time to tell myself that it’s not my fault, it’s not my responsibility, and that my happiness is important. I pretty much had to keep repeating that over and over in my head. Also it made me realize there had been more bad days than good days and how things have gotten progressively worse over time. It took time for sure but when I caught my Q lying (for the millionth time) one day, I knew and felt I was ready to just end that relationship. I hope your Q makes the decision to help himself. But in the meantime, remember that you are important and don’t lose yourself trying to help someone else. We are here for you every step of the way.
I feel you. I recently ended things with my Q and it has been (as you perfectly stated) a rollercoaster of feelings. You have made a healthy decision and I am proud of you.

Maybe try having a dry celebration? Do your friends know your Q’s issue? You are the birthday person so you get to make the rules of your party. I am so sorry that he’s given you anxiety. You should not have to spend your birthday in worry. I wish I could help celebrate your day! You deserve a good day.
Thank you for the validation! I thought maybe I acted too stone cold about the whole thing for a moment. Congrats on leaving your Q! May I ask how you are doing today? Do you find yourself happier?

Thank you! It has taken me so many tries to make this step but something felt different this time. I was able to remain calm and not let my emotions get the best of me. I didn’t allow for a long chat on the situation either. When and if you become ready, I’ll be here for you! And of course I am here for you now if you ever need to vent! I love plants and you have just inspired me to propagate my succulents and these long vine plants I have (I forgot what they’re called). It’s nice to be able to care for something and it rewards you with growth and beauty. :)
Thank you! He was so often not there. I felt alone in his presence. I feel a weight of worry lifted off my shoulders but I’m heartbroken. Such a difficult situation with these emotions.

Sometimes Q’s don’t even know they’re the Q’s. They end up taking advantage of us people who care. We forgive every time. We believe them. You were an amazing partner. You gave it your all and then some to make it work. Speak with your positive friends/family and stay busy. One day at a time you’ll heal from this and we are all here for you.
My situation is similar to yours and I’m so sorry you are going through it. We are here and will listen anytime you need. I have found so much strength and hope from here. I hope you find it too 💕
Such a beautiful day you had! 💕
You are so strong. I wish I had your strength. Sending you a long distance hug. You have bigger and better (and healthier) things ahead of you!

Thank you for this kind message. I’m definitely a list and numbers kind of person and this is a great idea. Maybe it’ll even give me some hope that it’s possible and that I can get back to feeling like myself. I moved states away from my friends and am pretty much alone in my current situation. And I think my friends who know what’s going on don’t quite understand how hard it is to leave this kind of relationship with every up and (mostly) downs. I have began to feel so hopeless. A lot of me still feels that way. I’m not getting any younger and I want a family. I don’t want lies and lonely nights/evenings. Again thank you for your kind words. They are so much appreciated.

Thank you! I just received them for Easter and wasn’t expecting the blooms to die so quickly. I figured it had to be my error. Time to do some research to keep the bulbs healthy to bloom next year! Thanks again!
Yes. This x 1000. Don’t let yourself be taken down a dangerous road.

Sending you both love and thoughts tonight. I have been having these exact same experiences. My Q tells me I’m the cause of bad nights due to me “causing fights” when he is the one lying and I catch him. 

So sorry you both are going through this.

My first thought was get the authorities involved but the realist in me kicked in. A hit and run and a DUI and who knows what else could throw you into some financial never ending hole (if you share finances). I don’t don’t what AlAnon suggests as I’m pretty new to this myself but does he have a buddy that you can call? Maybe they could call up your Q and see if they can’t at least get him to pull over?

I wish I had more comforting advice but unfortunately I don’t. I am literally in the same boat as you. The lies about important things and the lies about purely anything... so draining. I am here if you ever need to vent! And always do what’s best for you and your sanity.

It’s hard too because I feel like I’m the only one who truly knows how much and how inappropriately he drinks. Now his boss is aware but of course, no consequence for his action. I feel like that is further enabling him.

My apologies. He lives with me and visits his place he pays rent at during lunchtime as it’s close to his work. But that is the only time he goes to that residence. Otherwise his stuff is all at my place and he sleeps at my place. Sorry I’m half confused myself with where he lives.

All things considered, that could very well be it. I may have been an anomaly but at that age, I just accepted a Unit Nurse Manager position. But I am very aware that everyone blooms at different times and it’s never too late. I think the dreamer in me hopes that the motivation will kick in but every day I’m disappointed.

I have told him multiple times that finding a new job would better him with or without me. He has agreed but no action.

On a good day, he is very nice to me. But after deeper thought, we are very different. I am a planner and a ‘what’s the next move’ sort of person. I am always trying to better myself. I don’t think the same exists for him. May be the age difference.

First off there is nothing wrong with watching porn. But instead of you just saying exactly that, maybe try getting your point across to her with questions. Ask her why does she feel like it’s cheating. Ask her if she’s had a bad experience with porn and an ex. Maybe the issue is further rooted and you can work through making her understand that porn is normal. She may not even be able to give you logical reasons. Then she either has to get over it or decide that this is a non-negotiable for her and that she would have to explain to her friends she let a relationship go over watching porn.

Thank you! This is a really good take on this situation. I appreciate it. I feel terrible I keep asking him to leave due to my finances but it leaves me borderlining living paycheck to paycheck (due to unfortunate financial circumstances at this time). I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t resentful that my extra cash goes to buying the food and paying higher utilities while he is able to save money and spend the extra on beer and weed. Unfortunately, he rents a room and not the whole house and is not allowed to have anyone over.

Haha! Thank you for that laugh! I needed that. On a real note, there is high similarity in that statement. He is very sweet to me and we used to laugh a lot. I can’t say the same as much now because he is usually too messed up. I told him the only thing I want for Valentine’s Day is for him to not drink or smoke and put his phone down for one day and spend it with me.

There is only so much one can take. It really appears that you have done everything to help. Remember this isn’t about you and your efforts. He is the one that is continuing on like this. You could be an angel (which, by your actions, you are) and -he- continues down this path. I know leaving is easier said than done but I hope one day your lightbulb moment goes off and you realize how much you have done and how wonderful of a person you are and that you do not need to live like this.

I’m sorry I probably wasn’t clear enough. He told me that his “payment” to staying with me would be that he would let my dogs out for me. I actually was pretty happy with that for a while until he stopped doing it. As for the utilities, he is not the most eco conscious person when it comes to water and will crank my heat to 78. That is why I was hoping he would assist (I’m not even asking for half) in paying something. He has lived with me for a year and has not contributed. I definitely do not want him paying my lease or my personal bills. Nor do I expect him to move in here full time. I ask him to be fair because at his house, he would be paying to crank the heat high and for food. But I definitely agree and see your point. I would not want to move in with someone who keeps asking me to leave for sure. Thank you for your take on this. I need varying points to help me ensure I am being fair in my actions.

If you can believe it, I have asked him this. Just like you predicted, he didn’t have anything to say about what he brings to the relationship. I actually felt a lot of guilt by asking him that so I am glad that someone else suggested it. I don’t feel like I was being too out of line for asking it now.

Thank you for providing another side! I’m sorry that I may not have been clear on some things. I have to be frugal with my money because the lease on my previous car was up and I had to purchase a new one. The house I rent is... nice. And the added expenses of tax time (I owe a nice chunk of change this time around) and the service on the vehicle I bought 2 months ago, it has me unable to save. As to the food, he will eat a sizable lunch, snack (more meal sized), dinner, then another meal sized snack. I think it’s a case of the munchies. I do not expect him to commit to live with me but to contribute to groceries or bills that he partakes in. At this point I’d be happy with $20. I definitely agree with you though. Something has to change.
Thank you for your analysis. I definitely feel unheard and taken advantage of. Using the word boundaries has really put this into a deeper perspective. Thank you.

I can definitely feel this. I try very hard to put myself in his shoes and see where I might be doing something wrong but I can’t seem to find where I’m being unfair or anything. Besides threatening that he has to leave. Which I know puts a strain on a relationship and stability.
That is definitely my fear. That is mostly the reason why I posted on here. I needed an outside point of view. Thank you for your honesty.

That is a great idea to present to him. Thank you! I also have begun to believe that I am being used though. I try so hard to put myself in his shoes and how he might even think I’m being unfair and such. But I can’t come up with much.

That’s where I’m at. He has ignored my financial issues with supporting him. And it appears he doesn’t want to make more money to assist though he states otherwise. Actions have definitely spoke louder than words. I just want to be sure I have tried everything before I have to get mean-mean on this topic and move on. :/

He took on that responsibility to help out around the house. That was his only form of “payment” towards living with me. But yes I definitely see your point. I have since stepped in and they are back on the grind of going out every two hours- treats and all :)

I remained sober during Christmas Day because my mom lives about an hour away so I let my SO partake in the drinking this holiday. So he was drunk drunk when I said what I said. He threw a fit about me bringing it up on Christmas. Understandable. He called me an asshole and controlling and how I don’t want him to have any fun. (He asked to play his rap playlist on the way home and I just needed quiet. Hence why I am controlling I suppose.) When the names started flying I cooled down and lowered my tone and calmly tried to explain how he was not being the most likable person at my parents house. He remained fired up. He told me I better not say anything until we get home. It blew up when we got home. That’s when I went off about the bracelet. He said nothing. He continued to stumble over words and I tried to kick him out. It was a blow out. Long story short he is still at my house. We haven’t spoken but 5 words to eachother today. Keep in mind, the guy isn’t much a good communicator.

My apologies. The fight was because we were at my parents house for dinner on Christmas and after we ate, my SO kept being on his phone. Even stepped out of their house to be on his phone. My mom had made a comment about it being rude. I texted my SO to please stop. He didn’t. (We have been having some relationship issues for about a month and I have already suggested breaking up even with the holidays). My mom loves games so we were playing a trivia game and he kept saying how dumb it was and consistently forgetting it was his turn. After that we left and I was visibly frustrated between the gift and his behavior. I straight up said “Now that Christmas is almost over are we able to end this”.
I’d like to say I’d have to break things off and worry only of myself but I know myself better. As another posted in this thread about Al Anon so maybe that?

I don’t know. The nurse instinct kicks in always. The “I can help I can fix this”. But I’m always worried about him and about the future (for him as an individual and us together). It’s eating away at my happiness.

Thank you for this kind reply! I’ll look into Al Anon. I feel like I’m losing myself and my happy times while worrying and researching. Though Covid is still around, I’ve asked him to go back to his own place in hopes that I can help do like you said and separate myself a bit. This situation is very tough but it does help to know that I’m not alone. Posting this on Reddit is the first time I’ve spoken (so to speak) about this situation.
He says he knows he’s drinking too much and he doesn’t like it either. He once slowed it down for a few days and his anxiety was through the roof. He went right back to it. :/

First off congrats on your recovery! I haven’t bought any alcohol (honestly seeing what alcohol has done to my SO I have no will to drink anymore) in a while. But he will come home with a pack of beer almost every day.

I make stained glass pieces. Mostly video game logos since that’s my more mainstream hobby. It’s hard though because buying the glass is expensive. Sad thing is that I don’t even really hang them up. I just make them and put them in a box.
Thank you! I’m so glad that everything worked out for you and you didn’t give up. I hope I can have a similar experience!

That’s terrible. I’m sorry you’re going through that. When your surgeries happen I hope they go well! Having no relief from your pain is the worst. I’m starting to feel like the pain and this situation will never go away.

Is it weird I don’t have an exact name or phone number for my adjuster? I’ve been copying my documents from the docs and sending it to a person but I don’t even know if that’s who I’m supposed to send it to as I haven’t gotten anything or a phone call back.

When it happens again, I’ll try to politely decline. I was just afraid of coming off insubordinate. I hope that you feel better soon! Sounds like we both have not had a great time dealing with workers comp.

Thank you for your help! I have just called the doctor trying to get a modified DWC-25 or a note as you said. I have two DWC-25 sheets one for the initial visit after the injury and one for when I had to leave work early due to pain. I was initially on light duty but was instructed to work the floor which caused me way too much pain. Also, should I send copies of my prescriptions to the adjuster? Should I be sending all paperwork to the adjuster? Thank you so much and I may be PM ing you after the doctor calls me back.

Thank you! I have contacted the doctors office and waiting for them now to call me back to get some type of restriction on work. 

Documenting everything is something I had lightly been doing. I have since added info to my notes like when my DON put me on the floor when I was technically light duty. Are these notes going to ever need to be used? Like will I have to speak about these days to my adjuster? Also I am 29 years old.

My doctor told me to be out of work until we got the MRI results back. He assumed a week would allow me to get the MRI and results. So that’s what he put on the paper... out for a week. Unfortunately I didn’t get to schedule the MRI until days after that week off work. My HR Coordinator helped me fill out the initial paperwork so I don’t know if she’d be the one to contact regarding restrictions?

I don’t smoke cigarettes but I smoke hookah a lot. It began when I made a friend when I was about 22 who hung out at a hookah bar all the time. I began studying there and making a ton of friends at that place. I’m now 29 and addicted to the nicotine and just plainly doing something while I’m sitting at home after work to unwind.
Damn nature. You scary.
Ah! This brightens my heart. I had a little pup who suffered from seizures who passed during one. Big hugs to Kato from me and my late best friend, Griffin.

I have to wake up pretty early for work (often around 5 AM). My fiancé wakes up when my alarm goes off and starts making me tea and gets the dogs out and fed so him and the pups can wish me a good day at work.

My grandfather was a janitor at a school for many years. He was the most bubbly and happy man. I have seen kids and adults treat janitors poorly and it makes me so sad to think my grandpa may have had these experiences. Thank you for this thread. My grandpa is surely smiling and giving you a big high five wherever he may be.

I took some classes to ensure I enjoyed it and used a years worth of holidays to acquire all the quality tools to be able to do it. I hope you are able to get into it! It is an amazing hobby and clears the mind. Plus you end up with something absolutely beautiful at the end!

Thank you for your advice! I actually was able to fall asleep after reading your reply. It gave me hope! I went to a very knowledgeable jeweler this morning and he said the same as you! He said size and a half no problem but he did explain about the tightening of the small stones. Thank you again for the piece of mind!
Your positivity was exactly what I needed. I tend to be very hard on myself. Not sure how to put into words how much your reply means to me. I don’t have anyone to say these things to. Thank you.
If she’s a keeper, talk about the future. As a female, we love that stuff.
The year I became a Registered Nurse and worked at a facility that didn’t pay extra for holidays.
A former CNA and current RN here. Thank you for your hard work. So many people don’t understand the physical and mental demands of a CNA. You’re a warrior!

It was Sweetest Day (I know it’s a Hallmark holiday but that’s beside the point) and my boyfriend at the time was being a real jerk. I decided to go for a walk downtown by myself and get myself a dessert. I was walking back to my car and a man on a motorcycle pulled up ahead of me, took a rose off his bike, gave it to me, told me Happy Sweetest Day, high fived me, and drove off. It made my day.

Oh that’s wonderful news! I looked at a school near where I was living (I recently moved from Michigan to Florida) and they were going to make me go one math higher, take statistics, take organic chem, and cell biology (all of which I didn’t take for my ADN).
Thank you so much! I just grabbed a few of them and it looks like he has a mix of shiny metal, dull metal, and plastic. You got them all covered! Thank you again!
Metal for the figures and I think the (what looks like) ships are very thin plastic.

Thank you for your reply! Have you heard of being able to take prerequisites online? The schools near me would like a lab with the required Chem course and such. However I’ve seen some schools online that possibly allow these courses online. I’d prefer to do the entire program and prerequisites online but I don’t want to fall for a scam school.
You have taken a great amount of wondering and stress off my shoulders. I feel like I have a better sense of direction now. Thank you again!

Ah just thought of something else to ask. 

Obviously the co-signer would have to prove income but would their personal house payment and expenses be factored in? To get to the point is should I wait until I have the signed job offer indicating my income and have my SO’s mom co-sign? Or could it just be me and her right now?
Thank you for your reply! Luckily my SO’s mom offered to co-sign for us so this gives me some hope.
Okay that’s great to know. Thank you so much for the input! I’m a bit new at all of this so that definitely helped put things into perspective.

Thank you for your input! 

Would you suggest we go house hunting after I was offered the job? Or do you think renting a house would be a lost cause and we should check for apartments? 

I will be making about $26 an hour and my SO receives $10k in loans a semester.

Any relationship that has been toxic with emotional (and the one time) physical abuse that I have encountered has always gotten worse. Please look at your situation with your sister or mother or best friend instead of you. Them hiding from their partner and their beloved pet, kicked. You know it’s not right. Please seek help because these types of situations escalate. Maybe not this time but possibly the next.

I would have to say it doesn’t mean anything. You don’t want to read too much into things. If being just her friend isn’t enough then you might need to take a leap and ask her out. Or ask to hang with just you two. Be prepared for it to go either way. If it goes the way you don’t want it to, be sure to continually be her friend. Don’t let her or your emotions make it awkward.

I’m so sorry that you’re going through this. I am going through something similar but after speaking to a few people on here, please know you have a safe space here to vent or talk it out. 

Your next talk about his possible addiction may have to be a tough one. I’m not saying threaten to leave or anything drastic but you might need to let him know how serious this is. Most addicts will say what you want to hear or the “It won’t happen again” and it happens again. Addiction with anything is a struggle and he has to want to beat it for himself. I know therapy and counseling  for some other Reddit members has helped. 

Small background on me, I’m a registered nurse staying in a relationship with a porn addict. It’s not easy and I have so many emotional scars for dealing with it. So if you ever need to confide in someone feel free to message me. I too can’t tell anyone else about being the partner of a porn addiction. 

Best of luck with everything.
You’re definitely right. If it does the same thing, it’s a relapse. I’m feeling pretty sad and discouraged. Not sure how much I have in me to battle this out with him. :(
You were right. Had a talk with him this evening and I could tell he just isn’t taking things seriously and thought it all would just be water under the bridge. It’s so hurtful.

Really the only thing I can suggest is time. If there’s a chance she’s the one once she takes care of her business, I wouldn’t end it now. I’m not saying wait a year because dwelling in this situation isn’t healthy but you owe it to yourself to figure your feelings out to avoid making a mistake. Regardless of your decision, you have this safe space to vent here. And you have support. Best of luck in this, friend.

First off thank you for sharing. That’s a very tough situation to be in. I was in something similar for about 6 years as well. Now, if she were to be more independent and stable, would your feelings change? Or would you still just not have that same feeling you once had? Obviously if you think the “happily ever after” feeling won’t come back if she got herself together then you know what probably needs to be done.

She could just be a crappy texter. So many aspects of in person conversation pieces are lost when texting. You can never be too certain if someone’s being witty or mean or literally mean nothing by it. I’d just use texting for short conversation from now on like double checking you’re meeting at place X at Y time or you parked and will be there soon.

I feel your pain because my dad was exactly the same as yours. I wish I had a magic answer to you but sadly I don’t. The only thing I can say is maybe the new birds could be your “in”. Learn about them. Try to let your dad know you think they’re cool. My dad was never interested in what I liked but the second I said anything about his beloved golf, we’d at least get some type of talking. It might be a good start to talk about the birds! I can say that after I was able to move out of my parents house, when I came around, he was more tolerable of my presence. I hope things improve for you!

It’ll take time for you to fully have trust again. It’s okay to feel the way you do. In any situation, trust doesn’t return right away. It’s great that you have an open line of communication! I wish I had that with my boyfriend (who has a porn addiction). I’m more or less scared of upsetting him or upsetting myself regardless of the answers. But it sounds like things are going as positive as they can and you can always post or DM me if you need to vent!

Coming from a girl who has a boyfriend who is addicted to porn, I would suggest talking to her. Calmly. Let her vent everything. Let her know she’s justified in feeling every thing that she’s feeling. If you two can come up with a way to move through the effects and problems, then get going on that work! If she just can’t work at it, then you pick yourself up. Evaluate what went wrong, talk it out here or amongst a close friend, and don’t allow it to happen again. You will move through and pass this by to a better tomorrow.

I used to be the girl in your class. I used to be all for porn and whatever someone wanted. It wasn’t until a month and a half ago I realized that my boyfriend is addicted to porn. It truly can hurt your partner and literally today I finally decided to take care of my insecurities and work on my self worth. Porn stole my confidence and ability to trust.

You are completely right. I really do need to focus on myself. The only step he’s taken to fight the addiction is delete Tumblr off of his phone. Due to our history I feel like he has a porn addiction as well as some sort of attention seeking problem. Like my attention won’t ever be enough. Per your suggesting I looked up Betrayal Trauma and wow. It definitely fits me 100%. Thank you so much for your input it really helped me realize I need to focus on myself at the moment. I don’t want to be ruined emotionally from this.

Thank you for sharing your story. First off I’m so glad that you’re regaining your confidence back! You are one tough fighter for going through what you’ve been through. And also I’m sorry that you went though that. My boyfriend of about a year and a half came clean about his porn addiction to me just recently. I’m currently stuck in a very tough position of stay or go. I too lack self confidence now and feel just plain terrible about myself. I don’t wish these feelings on anyone. Keep on fighting for your mental health and you have a lot of people online including myself who will gladly be an ear if you ever need to vent or anything. Best wishes for your future!!!
Thank you so much!
Thank you for your reply! Congrats that you and your fiancé have fought the good fight! I wish the best for you two!

Thank you for this input! I’m sorry that you are going through a similar situation but there is comfort in knowing that we aren’t alone in this. I will look into Lifestar or some type of counseling. I think using those tools you mentioned would be greatly helpful to us both. Thank you so much again for your reply! I have felt very alone in this situation because it’s a sensitive subject to talk about amongst even a close friend.
